mapper.sql: FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id LEFT JOIN layout_template lt ON lt.layout_template_id = pu.layout_template_id LEFT JOIN authorization az ON az.authorization_id = rl.authorization_id AND az.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id LEFT JOIN agency ag ON ag.agency_id = az.agency_id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id AND o.end_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN person op ON op.person_id = o.person_id

WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND ag.agency_id = #{query.agencyId} AND rl.status = #{query.status} AND rl.listing_mode = #{query.listingMode} AND lt.layout_type = #{query.layoutType} AND rl.monthly_rent >= #{query.rentMin} AND rl.monthly_rent <= #{query.rentMax} AND (c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR b.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pu.property_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rl.listing_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT rl.rental_listing_id, c.community_id, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, pu.property_no, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', b.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, COALESCE(lt.layout_type, '未填') AS layout_type, COALESCE(lt.layout_name, '未填') AS layout_name, pu.gross_area, rl.listing_mode, ag.agency_id, ag.agency_name, rl.monthly_rent, rl.available_from, rl.published_at, rl.closed_at, rl.status, CASE WHEN rl.published_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN rl.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(rl.published_at)) ELSE DATEDIFF(DATE(COALESCE(rl.closed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), DATE(rl.published_at)) END AS listing_days ORDER BY CASE rl.status WHEN 'PUBLISHED' THEN 0 WHEN 'RENTED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rl.published_at DESC, rl.rental_listing_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT rl.rental_listing_id, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', b.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, COALESCE(lt.layout_type, '未填') AS layout_type, COALESCE(lt.layout_name, '未填') AS layout_name, pu.gross_area, CASE WHEN op.full_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(op.full_name, 1), '**') END AS masked_owner_name, rl.listing_mode, ag.agency_name, az.status AS authorization_status, rl.monthly_rent, rl.deposit_amount, rl.available_from, rl.published_at, rl.closed_at, rl.status, CASE WHEN rl.published_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN rl.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(rl.published_at)) ELSE DATEDIFF(DATE(COALESCE(rl.closed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), DATE(rl.published_at)) END AS listing_days, rl.listing_title, rl.description WHERE rl.rental_listing_id = #{rentalListingId}

SELECT SUM(status = 'PUBLISHED') AS current_published_count, SUM(status = 'RENTED') AS rented_history_count, SUM(listing_mode = 'SELF') AS self_count, SUM(listing_mode = 'AGENCY') AS agency_count, SUM(status = 'RENTED' AND YEAR(closed_at) = #{year}) AS rented_in_period_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN monthly_rent END), 2), 0) AS average_monthly_rent, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(published_at)) ELSE DATEDIFF(DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), DATE(published_at)) END), 2), 0) AS average_listing_days FROM rental_listing

SELECT c.community_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id GROUP BY c.community_id, c.community_name ORDER BY value DESC, c.community_id
SELECT listing_mode AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing GROUP BY listing_mode ORDER BY listing_mode

SELECT COALESCE(ag.agency_name, '业主直租') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl LEFT JOIN authorization az ON az.authorization_id = rl.authorization_id AND az.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id LEFT JOIN agency ag ON ag.agency_id = az.agency_id GROUP BY COALESCE(ag.agency_name, '业主直租') ORDER BY value DESC, label
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT CASE WHEN monthly_rent < 3000 THEN '3000 以下' WHEN monthly_rent < 5000 THEN '3000-4999' WHEN monthly_rent < 8000 THEN '5000-7999' ELSE '8000 及以上' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing GROUP BY CASE WHEN monthly_rent < 3000 THEN '3000 以下' WHEN monthly_rent < 5000 THEN '3000-4999' WHEN monthly_rent < 8000 THEN '5000-7999' ELSE '8000 及以上' END ORDER BY MIN(monthly_rent)

SELECT COALESCE(lt.layout_type, '未填') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id LEFT JOIN layout_template lt ON lt.layout_template_id = pu.layout_template_id GROUP BY COALESCE(lt.layout_type, '未填') ORDER BY value DESC, label
SELECT agency_id, agency_name FROM agency WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY agency_name, agency_id
